payload.goal: Learn from round 3: diagnose every loss, fix each with a predicted gain stated before it is built, upgrade the benchmark harness where it failed us, then prove the fixes on round 4 — a fresh held-out chain, 3 reps — and ship stable only if the D19 lead-margin gate passes.

plan.brief: Operator, 2026-10-04: "Starting the initiatives for the benchmark and everything. Our goal is to learn from the mistake and improve in the next benchmark. Improve and fix the problems that we face and that we lack, and then test the new benchmark. That was also a part of our goal"

tasks.title: 3-rep readout per pre-registered claim (PRE-REGISTRATION-R3, memory-lead 5.4): per-rep values, pooled margins, CIs; list every miss as a loss row with evidence

Cost attribution per agent (Claude, Codex, Cursor): split each sofar cell's tokens by source — digest, alwaysLoad block, raw .sofar reads, tool output — against native and beads; find why non-Claude agents cost 1.4–2× tokens
Wall-time decomposition: lock-wait vs agent time vs turns per session, per arm; separate queue starvation from real slowness
Early-chain variance: is rep 1's S2–S11 dip (~82% vs 84–95%) a signal or noise across 3 reps? Read transcripts of the low sessions if it recurs
S18 merge post-mortem across all arms and reps: which files conflict, how each agent resolved them, why rep 1 sofar broke the app (D36)

phases.name: Phase 2 — Product fixes (each states PREDICT before build; ablation per D5)

tasks.title: Generated projections never conflict on merge (plan.md, decisions.md, memory.md, sessions/*.md): events.jsonl union-merges, projections regenerate from it. PREDICT: 0 conflicted .sofar files at a Chain-L-style merge (rep-1 sofar had 3 extra, 8 vs 4)
Land memory-lead 4.3 (L35: ≤1 raw .sofar read per session) and 4.4 (L34: cap the alwaysLoad per-turn cost) — owned there; this task tracks them into the rc
Non-Claude context diet: whatever 1.2 finds for Codex and Cursor. PREDICT stated from 1.2's numbers before build
Fixes from 1.3–1.5 findings, one task per finding, each with its PREDICT

phases.name: Phase 3 — Benchmark harness upgrades (what we lacked)

tasks.title: Reboot safety: bench plists must not relaunch stale or finished jobs at login (RunAtLoad relaunched smoke-r3-h4/smoke-r3-h on 2026-10-03)
score-batch reads the round's own env (BENCH_CHAIN_DIR etc.) from its ledger or plist, so scoring cannot fail on a missing chain
Fair agent-lock scheduling: no cell starves behind the others (sofar r3 waited ~4h of its first 6h)
Operator hold/resume command for a running round (today: bootout + re-bootstrap by hand)
Per-agent cost and token readout built into check-rep (today hand-computed from ledgers)
Optional local-model smoke profile for runner development only, never a scored arm
Cut rc.5 with Phase 2: full suite, SPEC acceptance criteria, D18 read-path gate on both pinned fixtures
Publish rc.5 to npm next (operator runs the publish)
Fresh held-out chain authored blind (D22; chain-l-author pattern)
PRE-REGISTRATION-R4: claims with predicted margins from Phase 2, frozen in the operator's own words before any scored run
Smoke on the round-4 harness
Run 3 reps; score-batch and check-rep each
Readout per claim; D19 gate ruling; stable publish only if it passes
